cover.title: 5 niche habits of founders who check what chatgpt says about them

inner.title: ask five assistants weekly
inner.body: seer interactive ran 1,562 brand prompts across six ai platforms and claude declined 46.3% of them, ai mode only 24.1%. one assistant's answer says nothing about the other five.

inner.title: check the boring facts
inner.body: searchable asked chatgpt, gemini and perplexity over 72,000 questions about uk shops, and 64% of the businesses had at least one false fact. wrong postcodes showed up in 1 in 10 location answers.

inner.title: trace every wrong answer
inner.body: in seer's study one old office address was cited 223 times, and a churn story traced back to a single 2018 review. stale sources can change in days to weeks, so find the page it read.

inner.title: say what you don't do
inner.body: seer found assistants crediting the agency with a service it doesn't offer 109 times. misreading your own site is the fastest error to fix, and it's your fault if the site never says no.

inner.title: keep one brand canon
inner.body: the company's own website made up about 35% of the 219,349 citations in seer's study. if your headcount, address and pricing live on one page, you can finally check the answers against something.
